note: Source documents are traced, never overwritten, and never committed: this public repository stores only their sha256 and revision. extract_sources.py --corpus DIR locates each file by sha256, so a changed document is detected as a pin mismatch. A used source with a null sha256 is reported as UNPINNED. Published sources are the Zenodo release cited in 'release'; several PDF file names still say 'Version 1.0' although their content is release v1.1.
precedence_rule: On notation, symbols and units the Notation Appendix governs; on equations and numerical worked values the Mathematical Specification governs; pre-registered criteria follow the OSF pre-registration. Unpublished drafts rank last.
